projects.title: Wedding Invitation Platform (Self-Hosted)
projects.description:
Developed a fully responsive, self-hosted digital wedding invitation platform with interactive features including pre-wedding video, guest management, venue details with Google Maps integration, dynamic photo gallery, comment system, like functionality, background music, and downloadable invitation PDF.

✨ Features Highlight:
• Pre-wedding video 🎥
• Guest system 👥
• Comments & likes ❤️
• Music integration 🎵
• Mobile responsive 📱

projects.title: Passbolt Password Manager
projects.description: Deployed a secure, self-hosted Passbolt password manager on AWS cloud infrastructure with custom domain and SSL encryption. Configured role-based access control, secure sharing, and email notifications to ensure safe credential management for teams. This setup enhances security, privacy, and full control over sensitive data compared to third-party solutions.

projects.title: Jellyfin Media Server
projects.description: Built a self-hosted Jellyfin media server with secure remote access capability without requiring a public IP address. Implemented networking solutions for external streaming, ensuring privacy and full control over media content. Optimized performance for smooth playback across devices.
